title: BleepJar
tagline: Community based consensus for negative reinforcement or I fucked up.
description: Putting a price on engaging in bad community behavior. In a normal swear jar, where the violator is forced to put cash in the jar directly, in the blockchain version, the other members of the group can vote to put tokens in for the violator, as well as having oracles to detect violation.
how_its_made: Using hardhat as dev environment with ethersjs/react as the front end. Using gnosis safe as a multi-sig wallet to keep track of punishment funds. Tried to generate the gnosis safe onchain directly without engaging through the gnosis safe UI and add more information to the safe setup for tracking the funds.
